message: 知的労働者の優雅な生活

name: Misa
message: 「Here you go, Nanaka-san. Check these over.」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gyaaaah! Why is there so much paperwork?! This has got to be a conspiracy by the evil secret society Bubuzuke!」

name: Ria
message: 「There's definitely more than last year, yeah. It's on a bigger scale this time, so it can't be helped.」

name: Synn
message: 「My eyes are starting to feel kinda blurry... Still, this is all so everyone can enjoy KiraFes, so I'll push through.」

name: Misa
message: 「Things are only going to get tougher from here, so if you're already forcing yourself now, you won't last.」

name: Ria
message: 「Here. These eye drops work wonders♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much.」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew. So refreshing~\s07」

name: Misa
message: 「...O-Onee-sama. I feel like my eyes are getting tired too, actually...」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Ahh, Onee-sama's eye drops... they work so well... haaah...\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「Y'know, my eyes are feelin' kinda tired too.」

name: Ria
message: 「Sure, but where am I supposed to put the drops?」

name: Paqy
message: 「First, you give me a lap pillow, Ria-chan, and--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Manas!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ignore the idiot... *sigh*, guess I'll get back to it. Even Lolo-chan is quietly working away--」
Indeed, Lolotte even had her eyes closed as she quietly worked...

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz... snore... snuffle...」

name: Nanaka & Misa
message: 「She's asleep!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gasp!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「W-Who is the audacious ruffian sleeping during Student Council duties!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That'd be you.」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now. It can't be helped. Even Lolotte-chan gets tired, you know.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. However, daily studying is still indispensable.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, that sounds tough.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Last night, the leader of the Tomato Gang made an appearance. There was simply no way I could miss that!」

name: Ria
message: 「Is that... on TV?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is studying the Human World!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just record your late-night dramas!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sigh... And here I am, so busy I could use all the help I can get...」

name: Jangara
message: 「Eee!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Welcome back~」

name: Tinun
message: 「Eee!」

name: Synn
message: 「Here you go. Thanks.」
I handed the two of them the strawberry candies I had kept in my pocket.

name: Sally
message: 「Aww, no fair, I want some too!」

name: Synn
message: 「No way, these are a thank-you for helping me out.」

name: Sally
message: 「Stingy~」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait, Sakura-kun! What are you scheming with demons for!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I had them deliver some documents that needed Helena-san's approval to the chairwoman's office.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh. Then these need approval too. Take care of it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Okay. Could you deliver these next?」

name: Jangara
message: 「Eee!」
Taking the documents, they flew out the window and disappeared.

name: Misa
message: 「...Somehow, those two seem more diligent than Lolotte-san.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is a remark I cannot ignore. I am quite diligent myself. Just earlier, I was not sleeping; I was merely closing my eyes to focus my mind.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even though you were literally snoring.」

name: Misa
message: 「...Well, at least she's doing something. Sally isn't even trying to lift a finger.」

name: Sally
message: 「How rude!? I'm doing way more work than Mochimochi!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mochimochi... Which of the working kids is that?」

name: Sally
message: 「That thing sleeping on top of the locker. At least I'm awake, you know. Better than an angel who was just napping.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Miss Tag-Along. What matters is the volume of work one accomplishes. Whether one is asleep or awake isn't the issue here.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, that's pretty much an issue too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, it's definitely true that Sally hasn't done a single thing.」

name: Ria
message: 「Sally isn't a Student Council officer anyway, so expecting anything from her in the first place is... well, you know?」

name: Sally
message: 「You could at least expect something from me!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yet you can't actually do anything anyway, correct?」

name: Sally
message: 「Grr, how humiliating!」

name: Sally
message: 「Just you wait, though--the Boss will sort everything out eventually!」

name: Synn
message: 「The Boss?」

name: Sally
message: 「Awawa, it's nothing.\s01」

name: Sally
message: 「Anyway, I'm an intellectual laborer. Give me work suited for my talents and I'll do as much as you want!」

name: Misa
message: 「Do you even know what intellectual labor means?」

name: Sally
message: 「Don't treat me like an idiot! Intellectual labor is intellectual labor. Sitting in a chair and spacing out.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not called labor.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you wanna force that definition through, it's 'idiotic labor'」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm an intellectual, okay? My brains are practically gushing out of my earholes.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's a subtly grotesque way to put it...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though your head would have to not be empty before anything could gush out.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmph! I'm an overflowing fountain of wisdom!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, intellectual or target shooting or whatever, I don't care--as long as you actually work!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Sally-chan. I have a favor to ask you.」

name: Sally
message: 「Starting right this second, I'm not free anymore. Oh, so busy, so busy.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. That's a shame. I only asked because I heard you were great at intellectual work.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you'd done it, everyone would've been convinced that Sally-chan is intellectual...」

name: Sally
message: 「Y-You actually believed I was intellectual?!」

name: Ria
message: 「I believe Sally-chan is intellectual too.」

name: Sally
message: 「If it's something simple that doesn't require using my head or tiring out my body, I might do it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Isn't that just mmph-mmph--」

name: Misa
message: 「Good grief, read the room a little.」

name: Synn
message: 「See, I want you to find out what Azel's doing when she skips class.」
Honestly, it's been bothering me for a while.
Lately, Azel hasn't even been showing up to homeroom.
Even today, I haven't seen hide nor hair of her since homeroom.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jeez, Synn, are you really that worried about that girl?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Helena-san did ask me to look out for her.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, that's true, I guess...」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides... I want Azel to have a more sparkling school life too.」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm worried about her too, though I can't exactly skip class myself just to tag along with Azel-san...」

name: Ria
message: 「But with Sally-chan, being outside during class doesn't count as skipping, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey. Could we ask this of you?」

name: Sally
message: 「...Azel. You mean the girl who showed up after the Student Council ambushed me with dirty tricks?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Calling it an ambush is a terrible accusation when we fought fair and square and you simply lost to sheer numbers.」

name: Synn
message: 「...You say one word too many too, Lolotte.」

name: Sally
message: 「Uhh, Azel. You mean that flat-chested girl who's always alone?」
Ugh. It kinda sounds right, though it's phrased in a way that makes it hard to say "yes."

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. That gloomy transfer student with no chest at all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa. Straight to the point.」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's not off the mark, though.」

name: Sally
message: 「Ah, hard pass on that girl.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why.」

name: Misa
message: 「For all her excuses, she just doesn't want to work.」

name: Sally
message: 「T-That's part of it too, but.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So it IS part of it.」

name: Ria
message: 「I trusted you, so being betrayed makes me sad...\s06」

name: Misa
message: 「Making Big Sister look so dejected is unforgivable!」

name: Sally
message: 「W-Whoa. L-Listen. Um, I'm telling you that's not all!」

name: Sally
message: 「It's just, like, I don't wanna get near her, or rather. I get a nasty vibe from her. Like a thick, suffocating aura.」
I whispered quietly.

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, you've been avoiding Azel too, haven't you, Paqy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it because she's put up a barrier or something?」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Maybe.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why is that.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just a hunch, that's all.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's a pretty strained excuse.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sure is.」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now, you two. Maybe there's something going on that we don't understand? Like her having a constitution that makes it hard for demons to get close to her.」

name: Misa
message: 「Taking even an excuse this strained seriously... Big Sister is as big-hearted as ever... How wonderful.\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Just as a hypothetical, though...」

name: Ria
message: 「You know how there are people who just don't get along, even if you don't know why? Like angels and demons, for example.」

name: Synn
message: 「Really!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmm. At least it's not because she's an angel. If she's an angel, I can walk right up to her no problem.」
Sally suddenly hugged Lolotte!

name: Sally
message: 「See, just like this.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「W-What do you think you're doing!」
Wings burst out dramatically from Lolotte's back.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aah. Tontoroooo!」
500-yen coins spilled out of the broken piggy bank, glittering.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yikes. Total disaster.」

name: Sally
message: 「Waaah, soooorry!」

name: Misa
message: 「Geez, we're already busy enough as it is!」

name: Ria
message: 「Anyway, we have to help pick them up.」

name: Sally
message: 「What are these round, shiny things?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's money.」

name: Sally
message: 「Does that mean with these, I can get beef bowls!」
S-So many of them! Just how much is this!? Maybe I could live off this without working for the rest of my life.

name: Paqy
message: 「Not a chance.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I doubt that's even enough for an average household's single month.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way... Just staying alive is incredible...」

name: Sally
message: 「With this much, even if one coin goes missing...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I will not allow it.」

name: Sally
message: 「Eek. I-I won't pocket any, I swear.\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The money goes without saying, of course, but if even a single shard of Tontoro is missing, divine punishment is scheduled to fall upon you, Omake-san.」

name: Sally
message: 「Eek!」

name: Misa
message: 「Her eyes are dead serious...」

name: Ria
message: 「I'll fix it for you once we gather everything, so don't make such a scary face, okay?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please do~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, Lolo-chan. I hate to say it, but isn't it about time you put your wings away?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Awawawawa. W-Wings? There's no such thing!」

name: Ria
message: 「Right. There aren't any. Even though they're pretty...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Exactly. They don't exist. If you're seeing them, it's just an optical illusion. After all, humans don't have wings!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You got that right.」
